origine_fr: En bas, 言, la parole ; en haut, 敬, le respect, qui donne aussi le son (jìng). Ce sont des mots qui mettent en garde : alerter. De là aussi la police, 警察.
origine_en: Below, 言, speech; on top, 敬, respect, which also gives the sound (jìng). These are words that put you on guard: to warn. Hence also the police, 警察.
